## File: facebookresearch_diffq/examples/fairseq/examples/simultaneous_translation/models/transformer_monotonic_attention.py

Prompts

```
['build a transformer monotonic model with encoder and decoder for simultaneous translation', 'build a unidirectional transformer model using monotonic encoder for source-only encoding', 'review the TransformerMonotonicModel decision_from_states method to decide whether to read next source token', 'review the TransformerMonotonicDecoder extract_features method to compute attention and read actions', 'build a transformer monotonic architecture configuration for IWSLT or WMT translation tasks']
```

Usage

```
{'build_transformer_monotonic_model': 'build a transformer monotonic model with encoder and decoder for simultaneous translation', 'build_transformer_unidirectional_model': 'build a unidirectional transformer model using monotonic encoder for source-only encoding', 'review_decision_from_states': 'review the TransformerMonotonicModel decision_from_states method to decide whether to read next source token', 'review_extract_features': 'review the TransformerMonotonicDecoder extract_features method to compute attention and read actions', 'build_monotonic_architecture': 'build a transformer monotonic architecture configuration for IWSLT or WMT translation tasks'}
```
